comment: Theming Phase 2b: package description and README repointed to the static theme classes — the SASS variables reference design tokens now shipped as static CSS by @fluentui/react-tailwind-theme rather than injected into the DOM by react-provider. Usage now imports @fluentui/react-tailwind-theme/styles.css once per document and passes a theme class to FluentProvider's themeClassName prop instead of a theme object to the removed theme prop. Adds @fluentui/tokens as a devDependency for the token-parity test. The emitted SASS variables themselves are unchanged.
